items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: In fact, I did a lot of Royal Heinz, Teddy Wilson, George Shearing, Jess Stacey, Errol Garner. In fact, I tried to cover practically every pianist of any importance that I could ever think of.

ctx.x: Yeah, and then I've heard you do several other things that I think are excellent in that same vein, like Taste of Honey. Has this phase of your musical personality ever been recorded accurately, you think?

No, I don't believe accurately. I've tried to put it across on some of the recordings. The album that I made here at the Gollywog that has never been released, I think, contains more of this than anything else that I've ever done. But it's been most unfortunate that it's never been released. And in this album, I attempted more styles, different things that I've ever done before. In fact, I did a lot of Royal Heinz, Teddy Wilson, George Shearing, Jess Stacey, Errol Garner. In fact, I tried to cover practically…

Mm-hmm. Speaking of records, what about records with bands where you function as a sideman, with any sessions that you think, either from your point of view or as a whole were more outstanding than others that you can think of offhand?
